comments.oasisdiamond: Front two clear when winning at Catterick so should be able to cope with the 6lb rise

Won 1 of last 4 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 1 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Most have questions to answer but not MADE ALL who continued the good work for his current yard with a comfortable win last week.

comments.jackrabbit: Beat only one rival in three races (1m1f-1m3f) for Amy Murphy; handicap debut
comments.madeall: Penalised for last week's win which was comfortable; looks the most solid of these
comments.maxthetiger: Eight-race maiden and his close second at Beverley is a standout
comments.nighthorn: Placed once for Andrew Balding but now 0-10 and looking regressive
comments.rorythecat: Capable on the Flat and over hurdles, but very poor in two jumps races this year
comments.transfuse: Six-race maiden who has mostly been well beaten; hardly solid in more new headgear
comments.wadacregiorgio: Some promise last year but hasn't kicked on at all since being gelded

races.raceComment: madeall is confidently preferred with a score of 57.6%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over rorythecat. Won 2 of last 6 starts. form.rpCloseUpComment: dwelt start, in rear, going okay but plenty to do over 1f out, pushed along and good headway inside final furlong, never near to challenge (inquiry held into running and riding; jockey said his instructions from a tricky draw in stall 10, were to drop in and seek to find cover somewhere around mid-division ideally before looking to mount his challenge between runners in home straight; however after mare had been slowly away he found himself towards the rear of the field and elected to fold across in behind runners and obtain the cover his trainer desired; he stated that despite being further back than intended, he was not that far off the leaders on settling and through the middle stages but unfortunately Blue Empress, which he was tracking in three wide line, was under pressure leaving back straight and thus was not providing him with a tow into the race and there had also been significant interference just in advance of him near 3f marker; as a result of this he was faced with the decision of either hooking the mare wide and making a long sustained run to improve his position, which he felt would not be viewed favourably by his trainer or take his medicine and continue riding for luck, hoping to find a passage between runners; he added that he was focussed on keeping mare balanced and going through the gears slowly before looking to pounce with a late challenge; he further added that mare had flattened out over final 110yds and she was being comfortably held by first three horses to the line; his explanation was noted)

verdict.comment: There's pace high and low so BRAZILIAN BELLE (nap) should get a nice tow into the race and she's looking a progressive sprinter.

comments.arnhem: Four races for this yard and been beaten big distances since fair fifth here in early May
comments.brazilianbelle: Well on top last week at Thirsk and looks progressive enough to cope with the penalty
comments.goodpoint: Third over C&D on good to soft in November and he may have needed his comeback run
comments.jmjhingree: Soft-ground maiden winner; encouraging fourth last week at Ayr; rain welcomed
comments.lastoutlaw: Two wins for previous yard included a 5f soft-ground handicap off 5lb higher
comments.missbrazen: In-form front-runner and well drawn in ten; obvious claims
comments.neverdark: Drawn out of contention at Chester last time; well treated and enjoys soft ground
comments.ourabsentfriends: Second run after wind surgery when close up last week at Ayr; ground versatile
comments.readyfreddiego: Well handicapped and returned to form with a near miss at Ripon; rain unwelcome
comments.sibylcharm: Versatile trip-wise but back over 5f here and slow starts have become a habit

races.raceComment: ourabsentfriends is marginally preferred with a score of 51.0%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over brazilianbelle. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 3 wins from 13 starts in similar conditions. verdict.comment: None of the obvious contenders would appreciate softening ground but KEEP ME STABLE arrives here bang in form.

comments.arbitration: Hampered when a beaten favourite at Doncaster most recently
comments.codepurple: Had the run of things up front when posting a better performance over 1m1f here recently
comments.judgmentcall: Stuck on a long losing run and has finished right out the back in his last three races
comments.keepmestable: Always looked the most likely winner over C&D three weeks ago; raised another 4lb
comments.meresidemadness: Back from a break to win well at Thirsk and handicapped to go well again
comments.novak: Having a good year with 6f/7f wins; ran in a Class 4 last time; wouldn't want rain
comments.shahnaz: Five-time winner, though she's at her best over further and is 0-6 at 7f
comments.thesweetescape: Maiden runs weren't devoid of promise but didn't offer much on handicap debut (7f)

races.raceComment: keepmestable is marginally preferred with a score of 55.9%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over meresidemadness. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight polytrack bends

verdict.comment: A great depends on the ground. World Of Darcy did well in the mud last autumn but a chance is taken on the 3yo SPEED OF MAAJID.

comments.abate: Solid start for yard last two starts; wore cheekpieces once (2021) and now tries blinkers
comments.agostino: Easily opposable on vast majority of turf runs, except for C&D second (good) last June
comments.angleland: Refound some form last two runs for 1st and 2nd at Yarmouth; best 2024 efforts were better
comments.apachestar: Last of his three wins (45 races) was in August 2023 but he could be a contender
comments.reconmission: Probably no ground worries; ran well in 2023 after a break; last turf win three years ago
comments.speedofmaajid: Beaten a head off this mark at Yarmouth (5f on good; unraced on softer) last Wednesday
comments.worldofdarcy: Won three in quick succession at 6f on soft/heavy last autumn; question over 5f

races.raceComment: reconmission is marginally preferred with a score of 49.0%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more reliable profile over agostino. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 30 attempts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight polytrack bends

verdict.comment: This looks a field to tread carefully with but MIGHTY REAL and Tommy's Promise are relatively unexposed and coming into some form.

comments.amal: Sole win (31 races) was in 2021; lightly raced these days and has not done much
comments.beluckybear: No form after three starts; takes a big drop in grade in first headgear
comments.blackbrook: Six races; has a little ability but his closest finish (last time) was over 6f on AW
comments.faifai: Best attempts over this far were on AW, beaten a head last time; no ground worries on turf
comments.hawajes: 99 days off before latest; blinkers (absent for last two runs) return; might bounce back
comments.ladydiesel: Seven runs in total; needs to show something new on debut for this yard
comments.lahinabay: Her 7f form is on AW; 2025 form on the slide but 6f turf form in 2024 reads well
comments.laurentia: 0-9 on turf; third over 7.6f here (good to firm) last time was one of her best turf runs
comments.mightyreal: Third over 7f on good to firm on his last two starts and he is now in calculations
comments.mountofgold: Low-level maiden who was tailed off last October on her only start on softer than good
comments.roundaboutsilver: Close 3rd in 7f classified here latest but on AW; long time since he ran well on turf
comments.scenario: Two minor honours over 1m on sound surface last August/September but not so good this term
comments.spiritcharmer: Almost no solid form for Andrew Balding (AW); well beaten last month for new yard (turf)
comments.supernovasteps: 1-14 record; not much luck with one thing and another this year; peak efforts on AW though
comments.tilsworthmax: 17-race maiden who has not shown enough to be considered seriously
comments.tommyspromise: Starting to find his feet; has stall 1 but he's one of the more interesting candidates
comments.voodooray: Last on his last four starts, off nearly six months before latest; different headgear now

races.raceComment: lahinabay is marginally preferred with a score of 48.3%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions over laurentia. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include superior ratings, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

comments.comedianleader: Has been running well since winning at Brighton (1m) in April; trip query on rare 6f run
comments.dubaimagic: Placed three times on AW for James Tate; below best for this yard; cheekpieces on
comments.jagetme: Finished third in first two starts this season but disappointed latest; rain a concern
comments.lynwoodlad: Won a Brighton classified in June but needs to bounce back from Nottingham defeat since
comments.mammy: Ran respectably at Newbury (6f, good to firm) latest; on career-low mark; rain a concern
comments.maryofmodena: Now 15lb lower than soft-ground Newmarket win (5f) in 2023; well held since wind op
comments.romanemperor: Won 6f classified event at Yarmouth last time; back up 5lb; respected back in a handicap

comments.rovinia: Poor form in three starts on AW last year; this is more realistic; new yard; check market
comments.stalingrad: Just four runs since his 2023 win; beaten 1l over C&D latest; handles most ground
comments.symbolofhope: Below best in three starts on turf since returning from a 145-day break; more needed
comments.uptheanti: Won at Leicester (1m) on her final start for Jack Jones; returns to 6f on stable debut
comments.zaltalla: Regressive maiden; failed to beat a rival in his last three handicaps; drops back to 6f

verdict.comment: A Flat winner in Denmark, DUNKERQUE has a hurdles mark of 108 and may be equal to the task of conceding weight to all his rivals

comments.annilogsforce: Produced massive improvement at Fairyhouse with blinkers fitted, more required
comments.bheansaibhre: Solid claims but is due to run on the Flat at the venue on Monday evening
comments.coolboychristy: 15l runner-up in a Down Royal bumper, raced too keenly in a maiden hurdle at Roscommon
comments.dramaticlicense: Has an edge over Killian's Garden on Downpatrick running, not as good at same venue latest
comments.duelconcept: Second bumper run was a step in the right direction, a lot more needed on hurdling debut
comments.dunkerque: Holds a leading chance in this grade if forgiven a moderate display on handicap debut
comments.georginasjet: Third reserve, major improvement needed to feature in a maiden hurdle
comments.glitzandglamour: Probably owed her third placing at Roscommon to the exit of Bhean Saibhre two out
comments.killiansgarden: Did not seem to stay 2m3f at Downpatrick, previous C&D fourth was respectable
comments.krishnabellevue: Cost E54,000 as a 3yo; fourth foal; dam twice-raced French maiden hurdler, in good hands
comments.moneysharvin: Ran twice in points, reportedly unsuited by good ground on hurdling debut at Downpatrick
comments.nomoresilver: Made a lot of the running at Cork before fading to finish fourth, needs to settle better
comments.ourgirlellie: Attracted support when second at Sligo six weeks ago, this race looks more competitive
comments.rememberthename: Roscommon sixth suggests he is inferior to Bhean Saibhre and Glitz And Glamour
comments.thegreypoet: Yeats gelding is noteworthy as a half-brother to Grade 2 hurdles scorer Mister Blue Sky
comments.tudorista: Showed a tendency to jump to the right at Roscommon, might prefer a left-handed track
comments.whereareyounow: Second reserve, remote eighth after being badly hampered at the fourth on hurdling debut
comments.zambobbler: First reserve, dam well beaten in 2m hurdle on only start

races.raceComment: dramaticlicense is marginally preferred with a score of 45.7%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over bheansaibhre. Placed in 3 of last 5 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 4 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Yet to win at ballinrobe- in 5 attempts, though returning from absence and step up in class need consideration.

verdict.comment: Runner-up in two handicap hurdles at Sligo since a change of stable, SPICK AND SPAN reverts to maiden company with sound prospects.

comments.akmaam: Flat winner on AW in 2023, has run creditably on both hurdle starts for this stable
comments.bubbayeats: In rear in maiden hurdles at this venue and Wexford, shorter trip now, makes no appeal
comments.edenvalley: In rear in a bumper at Punchestown last year, no sign of ability in point-to-points
comments.justdennis: Completely tailed off in a Cork maiden in which Akmaan finished fourth, no apparent chance
comments.lastmandarcy: Never in contention in a maiden hurdle at Roscommon, can be safely ruled out
comments.loveatsea: Bumper winner, useful hurdles form, has had a break since a below-par run in March
comments.migdam: Four-time Flat winner, recent Flat form provides some encouragement, stable/hurdling debut
comments.nodemand: Seems to be improving on the evidence of a recent Cork fifth, place possibility
comments.nothinghectic: Shaped with some promise in two hurdle runs in May, form of Limerick fourth boosted
comments.redorwhite: Much improved when second at Sligo nine days ago, this company looks more demanding
comments.shannonbank: Needs to step up on the form shown in a Downpatrick bumper on stable debut.
comments.spickandspan: Runner-up six times including last twice, should be in the mix in a race of this standard
comments.streamsforthlad: First reserve, ordinary form in Britain, transformation needed on debut for Elliott team
comments.tacticalmission: Down the field in two maiden hurdle outings, nothing to suggest he can feature
comments.teagardenjazz: Second reserve, placed twice when trained by Gordon Elliott, has had plenty of chances
comments.townhilllass: Winner and twice second in points, no encouragement from her racecourse form
comments.waydownwego: Soundly beaten in fifth at Sligo nine days ago, this looks like a stronger contest

races.raceComment: spickandspan is marginally preferred with a score of 47.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form over nothinghectic. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 13 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Yet to win at ballinrobe- in 18 attempts. Key attributes include superior ratings, though step up in class and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: This is a big drop in class for KAPTAIN BAY following his run at Bellewstown. Race fitness may give him an edge over Realism

comments.allycay: Has had two Flat runs after a long absence, first run a lot better than more recent outing
comments.answering: Has lost form since a good spell in the opening months of 2024, blinkered first time
comments.belleofboston: Initial handicap mark is a reflection of poor maiden form, hard to make a case for her
comments.danielled: Mild promise in maidens, remote seventh at Kilbeggan in her first handicap, cheekpieces on
comments.dreamshaper: Yet to reach the first three in 19 races, has run well from time to time, others preferred
comments.eastmore: Should be better for a recent Wexford run, went close at Down Royal last August
comments.kaptainbay: Takes a drop in class after contesting a much stronger handicap at Bellewstown, respected
comments.onlyoneplan: Local hope, twice placed here, beaten almost 9l in second at Kilbeggan recently
comments.parkgarve: Half-brother to Supreme Novices' winner Slade Steel, early days, premature to dismiss
comments.realism: Group 3-placed on Flat early in career, placed over hurdles, first run for Enda Bolger now
comments.searoadfill: Potentially well-treated relative to his best chase form, lacks a recent outing
comments.silentdawn: Pulled up at Kilbeggan last time, could be given a chance on his Clonmel third in March
comments.stily: Good run over 2m3f at Limerick in May, longer trip did not appear to suit at Tipperary
comments.takechance: Second in a point, relatively unexposed sort, could slot in effectively on handicap debut
comments.wbeasy: Not beaten far in mid-field in two handicap attempts, has potential for improvement

races.raceComment: kaptainbay is marginally preferred with a score of 48.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip over onlyoneplan. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though step up in class and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The form of NET BOY's course maiden hurdle win has been franked by the runner up and he should be hard to beat on handicap debut

comments.bravecrogha: Bumper winner, tailed off on h'cap bow latest, hard to fancy off just 3lb lower
comments.drumgill: C&D winner, running well off higher chase mark before tame Kilbeggan effort, can rebound
comments.hastenslowly: Good run at Tramore in May but below par twice since, place chance if rediscovering best
comments.jakepeter: Back-to-back wins last year, struggled last twice off revised rating, may be on tough mark
comments.laurieblue: Minor promise in maiden hurdles, refused to race on Flat latest, risky on h'cap bow
comments.mercurymission: Up 13lb for two wins in March-April, has struggled off revised mark, h'capper in control
comments.netboy: Course maiden winner, form franked by runner up, of obvious interest on h'cap bow
comments.themediator: Dual-purpose, won Fairyhouse maiden in November, poor on Flat last twice, can't discount
comments.thenamesjock: Dual-purpose sort, out of form on the Flat, pulled up last hurdles start, hard to fancy

races.raceComment: netboy is confidently preferred with a score of 58.2%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more progressive and more reliable profile over drumgill. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include improving, though returning from absence and step up in class need consideration.

verdict.comment: With no penalty for last week's Chepstow win, HIDDEN VERSE (nap) is fancied to turn the tables with Fancy Dancer from Bath.

comments.ballsgroveboy: Pulled hard last time, having hit traffic previously, and this mark should be within range
comments.bustamoon: Three poor efforts for this yard since picked up from David Evans out of a claimer
comments.darkdreamer: Two previous runs on Tapeta weren't great and others have more pressing claims
comments.earlyrelease: Lacks consistency and the visor has quickly been dropped; should be happier back on Tapeta
comments.fancydancer: Continued the progress when going in off 4lb lower on turf latest; claims despite stall 13
comments.hiddenverse: No penalty for last Thursday's easy apprentice race Chepstow win and holds leading claims
comments.jakeloveslaura: Placed at a big price over C&D in May but has since finished last twice and is regressive
comments.koji: 2-4 round here, the wins coming at 33-1 and 20-1; not impossible she pops up from nowhere
comments.macsdilemma: Not run on the AW since 2022 and has regressed on turf in recent times
comments.masterdandy: Returns to Tapeta, a surface he likes, on a career-low mark; one to consider
comments.noblephoenix: Went backwards for Andrew Balding (7f-1m) before being sold for 1,900gns in the spring
comments.notjustyet: A few near-misses over C&D off higher marks; wide draw but no shock were he to pop up
comments.southdakotasioux: First run in a sprint in over a year; will need things to fall right from stall 9

races.raceComment: ballsgroveboy is marginally preferred with a score of 46.9%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions over hiddenverse. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
